task.title: Drop NUL-bearing SSE event types
task.objective: Discard completed events with U+0000 in their event value without affecting following events
acceptance_criteria: A completed event whose event value contains U+0000 is not dispatched
The dropped event does not consume the bounded dispatched-event allowance
Following valid events retain independent parser state and dispatch normally

attempts.summary: Added a regression containing one NUL-bearing event followed by a valid terminal event
attempts.diagnostic: The parser emitted both the invalid event and the following valid event

attempts.summary: Guarded completed-event dispatch and event-count increments on a NUL-free event value

outcome.summary: Malformed NUL-bearing event types are dropped while later valid events and resource accounting remain correct

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1086

lessons: Apply protocol-mandated dropping before dispatch quotas so rejected input cannot exhaust valid-event capacity
Reset per-event state regardless of dispatch so one malformed record cannot contaminate its successor
